item.title: A last look at the polls as Election Day begins
item.description: NPR's Michel Martin talks to Christine Matthews, a center-right pollster and president of Bellwether research and consulting, about the last polling ahead of Election Day.

item.title: Death toll hits 29 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with 48 still missing
item.description: Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles across nine regions, President Zelenskyy said in an online post that noted the barrage coincided with U.S. elections.
item.content:encoded:
Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles across nine regions, President Zelenskyy said in an online post that noted the barrage coincided with U.S. elections.

(Image credit: Ukrainian Emergency Service)

item.title: New restrictions at Texas Tech are changing what professors can teach
item.description: The rules have led to changes in course materials, prompted accusations of censorship and fueled pushback from faculty and students, including faculty departures, student protests and a federal lawsuit.

item.title: 'Messy,' 'divided' and 'scary': swing voters rate the country ahead of Election Day
item.description: One last check in with the Swing Shift voters before Election Day. All of them voted for President Trump. Now, they're rating his presidency and deciding who to support when he's not on the ballot.
